emails.title: Email addresses
emails.description: One address per line. Display-name forms ('Jane Doe <jane@acme.com>') are accepted, duplicates are removed before anything is checked.

emailText.title: Paste a list instead
emailText.description: For pasting straight out of a spreadsheet or CRM export. Separate addresses by newline, comma or semicolon. Merged with the list above.

verifySmtp.title: Check the mailbox over SMTP
verifySmtp.description: Ask the mail server whether the mailbox exists (RCPT TO, never DATA - no mail is sent). Needs outbound port 25, which many networks block; the run tests this once and reports the answer in the summary record instead of failing.

detectCatchAll.title: Detect catch-all domains
detectCatchAll.description: After an address is accepted, ask the same server about a random address on that domain. If it accepts that too, the domain takes everything and the acceptance proved nothing - reported as risky rather than deliverable.

treatRoleAsRisky.title: Treat role mailboxes as risky
treatRoleAsRisky.description: info@, sales@, support@ and the like are real mailboxes but carry higher complaint rates on cold sends. Turn this off to score them purely on deliverability.

includeMxRecords.title: Include full MX records
includeMxRecords.description: Keep the full MX list with preferences on each record. Turn off for a slimmer dataset; mxHost is always present.

onlySafeToSend.title: Only return safe-to-send addresses
onlySafeToSend.description: Output nothing but confirmed deliverable addresses. The run summary still counts everything, so you keep the real rates.
onlySafeToSend.groupDescription: Applied after verification, so the summary record always reflects the whole list.

onlyStatuses.title: Only these statuses
onlyStatuses.description: Keep only the statuses you select. Leave empty to return everything.

concurrency.title: Concurrent checks
concurrency.description: How many addresses to work on at once. SMTP conversations are serialised per domain regardless, so a list of many different domains goes fast while one big domain stays polite.

dnsTimeoutSeconds.title: DNS timeout (seconds)
dnsTimeoutSeconds.description: Per MX lookup. Results are cached per domain for the run.

smtpTimeoutSeconds.title: SMTP timeout (seconds)
smtpTimeoutSeconds.description: Per SMTP step. Raise it for slow or greylisting servers; a timeout is reported as unknown, never as undeliverable.

heloHostname.title: HELO hostname
heloHostname.description: The hostname announced in EHLO/HELO. Using a domain you actually control, with matching forward and reverse DNS, measurably reduces how often servers stonewall the probe.

mailFromAddress.title: MAIL FROM address
mailFromAddress.description: The envelope sender used during the probe. No mail is ever sent to or from it; some servers simply refuse to answer an empty sender.

emitSummary.title: Add a run summary record
emitSummary.description: Append one RUN_SUMMARY record with the status breakdown, deliverable rate, duplicates removed and whether port 25 was reachable from this run.

exportFormats.title: Extra export files
exportFormats.description: Also write the results to the key-value store in these formats. The dataset is always produced regardless.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy for the SMTP probe
proxyConfiguration.description: Outbound port 25 is blocked on the Apify platform, so mailbox-level checks only work if a proxy allows a CONNECT tunnel to port 25. Enable this to try; the run reports which route it used and falls back to MX-only when the tunnel is refused. DNS is never proxied.
